decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's secure communications portfolio that remained actively marketed in both 2023 and 2024, it likely meets at least a satisfactory aspiration level or is worth retaining under the firm's organisational slack while demand in the growing market becomes clearer.

Because this newly launched 2024 gateway fits tightly with the firm's established cloud messaging offer and there is no visible sign of shortfall, a large incumbent using behavioral logic would keep it and continue learning before reallocating resources.

This product is also a near-core complement to the firm's existing communication services, and with only one year on the market in a growing industry the firm would likely tolerate uncertainty and keep it unless results clearly fell below aspiration.
